value.rationale: This is a complete structural automorphism classification for an infinite-degree, three-parameter family whose amoeba contour is unusually rigid. It gives a sharp codimension-one enhancement and explicit geometric torus involution, distinguishes genuine intrinsic automorphisms from coordinate-deck symmetries, and supplies a natural invariant not determined by the contour result. This is not mere recomputation of the published amoeba theorem.
